project_info.name: Velandria MMORPG HUD Restyle & Trade System

design_philosophy.core_concept: Sleek Minimal Modern dark HUD overlays that maintain maximum 3D canvas visibility while giving players precision, tactile clarity, and effortless trade interaction.
key_principles: Tactile Glassmorphism: Dark semi-transparent panels with backdrop blur (12px-20px), razor-sharp 1px subtle borders, and subtle gold/amber ambient accents.
Content & Visual Hierarchy: Rarity colors pop cleanly with high WCAG AA/APCA contrast on deep charcoal/void backgrounds.
Non-Obtrusive Canvas Preservation: Compact grid densities, sub-pixel alignment, and refined paddings so HUD elements never obstruct 3D gameplay.
Smooth Micro-Interactions: Clean 0.15s cubic-bezier transitions for hover, active, drag, lock, and confirm states.

new_trade_system_spec.overview: Real-time 2-player trade system integrated into the HUD over 3D canvas.
user_flow: 1. Right-click player -> Context menu displays 'Trade with [PlayerName]'.
2. Click 'Trade' -> Sends WebSocket message { t: 'trade_req', id: targetId }.
3. Target receives trade request popup: '[PlayerName] wants to trade with you.' with 'Accept' and 'Decline' buttons.
4. Upon Accept -> Trade window opens for both players.
5. Players drag items from their inventory or click items to offer them in 'Your Offer' (12-slot grid).
6. Players enter Gold amount in input field.
7. Clicking 'Lock Offer' freezes the offered items & gold for that player (status changes to 'Locked'). Either player modifying their offer unlocks both sides.
8. When both sides are locked, 'Confirm Trade' becomes active.
9. When both click 'Confirm Trade', trade executes on server, items/gold transfer, window closes with success toast.

trade_window.layout: 2-column side-by-side offer areas + integrated inventory bottom/side panel

your_offer_section.title: Your Offer
your_offer_section.gold_input: Numeric gold input field with max limit validation

their_offer_section.title: Their Offer ([TargetName])
their_offer_section.gold_display: Read-only gold display with gold icon

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply pure CSS restyle to /app/frontend/src/App.css replacing old brown medieval gradient styles with sleek minimal modern dark glass variables and rules.
Implement Trade Window React component in /app/frontend/src/components/game/TradeWindow.jsx or inside Panels.jsx / HUD.jsx.

Integrate trade WebSocket events ({ t: 'trade_req' }, { t: 'trade_accept' }, { t: 'trade_offer' }, { t: 'trade_lock' }, { t: 'trade_confirm' }, { t: 'trade_cancel' }) with backend server and game state in store.js.
Update right-click context menu ContextMenu in HUD.jsx to add 'Trade with player' option for player target context menus.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes matching the test_ids spec.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.css_rule: Avoid universal transition: all. Use specific properties like transition: background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, transform 0.1s.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rule: Keep text contrast above WCAG AA against dark backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_id_rule: All interactive buttons, slots, inputs, and modals MUST have data-testid attributes.
